svg.title: To Sail the Starry Sky — Chapter I authentic native-engine scene review
svg.desc: Six byte-identical PNG screenshots reconstructed from exact native Godot 4.7.2 Linux OpenGL review runner receipts. Original 960 by 640 pixels embedded losslessly and scaled uniformly. Scenes show provisional review geometry and developer UI rather than approved cinematic game artwork. Source GitHub Actions run 40648637058, exact source 4d18fece404062f1630e0ea0633b934fdd07ac4c.
svg.text: FIRST WAKE / CHAPTER I — NATIVE GODOT REVIEW
Original Godot-rendered 960×640 frames · development geometry · not final art or released gameplay
